sanskrit:
असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः।
नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धिं परमां संन्यासेनाधिगच्छति।।
caption:
The stage of Renunciation. ‘asakta-buddhiḥ sarvatra’ (One who is self-controlled and unattached). ‘jitātmā vigata-spṛhaḥ’ (Who gives up all material enjoyment). ‘naiṣkarmya-siddhiṁ paramāṁ’ (Can attain that highest perfect stage of freedom from reaction). ‘sannyāsenādhigacchati’. By working without attachment, one eventually reaches the stage where one performs no material karma at all (‘Naishkarmya’). He acts, but the reaction doesn’t touch him.
